goals.description: Audit the requested widget, determine the applicable porting scope and precedents, and preload the files needed by each later goal without modifying the workspace.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Remain read-only with respect to /workspace. Identify the requested widget and repository root, inspect the repository layout and relevant skill references, and run the coverage audit from the skill folder with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 (using --repo when needed). Determine whether this is a missing wrapper, variant widget, or connector/render-state change; identify close precedents in the target and another flavor; note required exports, tests, placeholders, skippedTests entries, UMD constraints, and whether examples are appropriate. Build the preload plan from the complete DAG and predicted filesystem state at each goal's entry. Include concise, useful text paths for each of G001-G007, accounting for files predecessors will create, move, edit, or delete. For validation, include implementation/test files, references, and relevant package or validation configuration. Do not include dependencies, build outputs, caches, generated bundles, or SeaOfGoals files. Call set_preload_plan exactly once before ending, with JSON shaped {"goals":{"G001":["relative/path"],"G002":["relative/path"],"G003":["relative/path"],"G004":["relative/path"],"G005":["relative/path"],"G006":["relative/path"],"G007":["relative/path"]}}. Summarize the resolved scope, precedents, expected file ownership by goal, and important constraints for successors.
goals.name: Explore workspace and plan goal context

goals.description: Derive concrete acceptance criteria and exact validation commands from the task contract, audit, and stable repository configuration.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Using the audit and scope summary from G000 plus preloaded stable configuration, prepare a concrete validation plan without implementing the widget. State acceptance criteria for API behavior, exports, $$widgetType, render state, wrapper behavior, flavor registrations, placeholders/skips, React all-widgets coverage, types, linting, and examples as applicable. Select exact focused test, type-check, lint, and audit commands supported by this repository, including the correct working directories or package selectors. Avoid reading implementation files that concurrent goals may change unless the preloaded snapshot already supplies the needed context, and do not write into files owned by another goal. Produce a predecessor summary containing the acceptance criteria and exact commands for G007 to reuse and adapt only when actual results or workspace conditions require it.
goals.name: Prepare validation plan

goals.description: Add or update the connector and JavaScript widget layer, including appropriate exports and focused package tests, only where the resolved scope requires it.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the bottom InstantSearch.js layer required by the scope established in G000. For an existing connector with a missing wrapper, preserve the connector API and only add or update the JS wrapper if it is part of the request. For a variant, reuse the established connector and keep its distinct $$widgetType rather than creating a connector. For a missing connector or changed render state, implement that contract first. Follow the selected precedents and sharing model, add connector exports to connectors/index.ts and index.umd.ts when allowed, and widget exports to widgets/index.ts and index.umd.ts when allowed. Respect intentional UMD exclusions such as chat. Add or update focused InstantSearch.js package tests as needed, but leave cross-flavor common-suite wiring to G005 and G006.
goals.name: Implement InstantSearch.js foundation

goals.description: Implement the React hook and widget layers, exports, UI component, and focused React tests required by the resolved scope.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the React portion that is in scope, using the finalized or preserved InstantSearch.js connector contract from G002. Add a react-instantsearch-core hook and export only if the feature needs a new connector hook; variants must directly reuse the existing hook. Add the React widget and both widget index exports, preserving prop names and $$widgetType. Prefer instantsearch-ui-components where an existing shared factory fits; otherwise create src/ui/<Pascal>.tsx for all React-rendered markup, including simple markup. Do not add memoization unless an adjacent widget uses it for the same reason. Add focused React unit/type tests where appropriate, but leave the common widget-suite registrations, placeholder removal, skippedTests cleanup, and all-widgets switch entry to G006.
goals.name: Implement React flavor

goals.description: Implement and export the Vue wrapper required by the resolved scope, following established compatibility, mixin, slot, and rendering patterns.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the Vue portion that is in scope using the connector contract from G002 and the precedents selected in G000. For recommendation, chat, or filter-suggestions work, apply the inspected Hits.js, Highlighter.js, DynamicWidgets.js, and util/vue-compat.js patterns. Use an SFC for slot-heavy markup or a .js render function with renderCompat when reusing instantsearch-ui-components. Match createWidgetMixin, createSuitMixin, scoped-slot/component escape hatches, prop names, and $$widgetType; do not invent a new Vue pattern. Export the wrapper through packages/vue-instantsearch/src/widgets.js, relying on existing automatic re-export and plugin registration. Add focused Vue tests if needed, but leave shared common-suite setup, placeholder replacement, and skippedTests cleanup to G005 and G006.
goals.name: Implement Vue flavor

goals.description: Update shared connector coverage and flavor connector-suite registrations when connector parameters or render state changed.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Handle connector-level cross-flavor testing only when G002 introduced or changed connector parameters or render state. Update tests/common/connectors/<widget>/ with the shared behavioral contract and register or repair the suite in each applicable flavor's common-connectors test harness. Replace unsupported placeholders with real setup, remove corresponding connector skippedTests entries, and preserve existing APIs when the task is wrapper-only. Keep this goal confined to shared connector tests and common-connector registrations; do not edit common widget suites or implementation files except for a narrowly necessary test-discovered correction.
goals.name: Wire connector contract tests

goals.description: Complete shared wrapper coverage, flavor widget-suite registration, React all-widgets coverage, and any justified user-facing example integration.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Wire the completed wrappers into tests/common/widgets/<widget>/ whenever wrapper behavior is new or changed, and register the suite in every applicable flavor's common-widgets test harness. Replace target-flavor `throw new Error('X is not supported in ...')` placeholders with real setup and remove the corresponding widget skippedTests entries. Always add an in-scope React widget to packages/react-instantsearch/src/widgets/__tests__/__utils__/all-widgets.tsx with valid minimum props. Assert consistent $$widgetType and the relevant props, slots, components, and render behavior. Then inspect existing examples only if the widget is user-facing: prefer its established recommendation, chat, query-suggestions, or getting-started location, and add it to an e-commerce example only when it fits the shared storefront UX or existing Playwright coverage. Avoid example changes when they are not justified.
goals.name: Wire widget tests and examples

goals.description: Execute focused and repository-level checks for the implemented port, repair failures, and confirm coverage and export consistency.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Reuse the acceptance criteria and exact commands prepared by G001 rather than redesigning validation. Run the widget coverage audit again, then execute the focused shared connector/widget suites, flavor-specific tests, type checks, lint checks, export or UMD checks, and any applicable example or Playwright checks from that plan. Adapt commands only when actual output or workspace conditions require it. Verify that all in-scope flavors expose the feature, $$widgetType is aligned, variants reuse their connector/hook, placeholders and skippedTests entries are gone where support was added, React all-widgets coverage exists, and intentional UMD exclusions remain intact. Diagnose and repair implementation or test failures in their owning files, rerun affected checks, and report any checks that cannot be run with the reason.
goals.name: Validate complete port
